scope: Research backlog, not an implementation or validation certificate
source_note: Sources establish relevant capabilities or method families. A family reference does not imply every candidate is implemented by that library.
license_policy: Verify the exact selected release, redistribution obligations and data/model licenses before integration. No dependencies installed by this research.

priority_definitions.P1: Extend and validate existing potential-field/radiometric workflows
priority_definitions.P2: First new electrical and EM engines
priority_definitions.P3: Additional geophysical families and advanced regional workflows

families.name: Structural grid attributes
families.existing_note: Basic mathematical attributes and pixel graph paths are implemented; geological classification and CET equivalence are not established.
families.required_data: Explicit grid axes, projected spacing, wavelengths, noise threshold, quantization and feature mask
families.minimum_benchmark: Known orientations, analytic modes, topology and sensitivity to scale/noise/thresholds
candidates: Multiscale log-Gabor/Riesz phase attributes with explicit noise assumptions
Local histogram texture with declared quantization and missing-data support
Axial orientation diversity with explicit bin origin and support
Skeleton graph paths with branches, cycles and pixel geometry provenance

families.name: Potential-field interpretation
families.existing_note: Euler 2D/3D, profile Werner/SPI and radial power spectrum exist; field validation and advanced extensions remain separate.
families.required_data: Projected grids/profiles, heights, units, derivative provenance and noise estimates
families.minimum_benchmark: Known single/multiple sources, several sampling intervals, windows, noise levels and height references
candidates: Spectral depth estimation with explicit fit ranges and uncertainty
Directional spectra and anisotropy diagnostics
Full potential-field gradient tensors and invariants
Noise-aware Wiener regularization for spectral transforms
Matched-filter separation with explicit source-layer assumptions
Multiscale persistence and clustering of depth solutions
Confidence diagnostics for interfering sources and incorrect structural indices
Spatially varying observation-surface continuation through equivalent sources
Bounded planar ordinary kriging and empirical variograms with explicit uncertainty assumptions

families.name: Magnetics
families.existing_note: RTP/field transforms, derivatives, leveling and compensation already have implementations; do not duplicate them.
families.required_data: Magnetic anomalies, sensor positions, inducing field, calibration metadata and optional vector components
families.minimum_benchmark: Induced and remanent prisms/dipoles, low-latitude fields and independent holdout lines
candidates: Apparent susceptibility with documented geometry and field assumptions
Joint estimation of total magnetization direction for compact sources
Vector-component prediction and comparison against measured vector data
Spatially varying inducing-field transformations for large regions
Low-latitude RTP sensitivity and gain-selection diagnostics
Cross-survey magnetic datum harmonization with uncertainty
Independent recovery tests for vector and platform compensation
Compact magnetic-source fitting with positional and height uncertainty

families.name: Gravity and gradiometry
families.existing_note: Normal gravity, Bouguer/Airy and correction primitives exist. Some complete workflows remain QGIS adapters; external tide inputs are not an internal tide engine.
families.required_data: Observed gravity, station loops/times, calibration, elevation and vertical datum, terrain/bathymetry and density
families.minimum_benchmark: Closed loops, reference station ties, analytic bodies, terrain refinement and independent observed gravity
candidates: Internal solid-Earth gravity tide calculation with validated units and conventions
Ocean-loading gravity correction distinct from ocean surface-height prediction
Gravity tensor modeling and gradiometer orientation handling
Polygonal-body forward modeling and 2D/2.5D interpretation
Spherical tesseroid modeling for regional and global surveys
Nettleton/Parasnis-style density estimation with terrain-correlation diagnostics
Network adjustment of gravity loops, drift and instrument scale
Combined land/marine/borehole correction recipes with explicit datums

families.name: Gamma-ray spectrometry
families.existing_note: Concentration products and parametrized correction primitives exist; they are not a complete calibrated spectrometer pipeline.
families.required_data: Full count spectra, energy channels, live time, upward detector and cosmic channels, heights and calibration surveys
families.minimum_benchmark: Reference peaks, pads/ranges, Poisson spectra and independent calibrated channel products
candidates: Energy gain/offset stabilization from spectral peaks
Noise-adjusted SVD spectrum denoising
Maximum-noise-fraction spectral denoising as a separate method
Temporal radon estimation from upward/downward detectors
Pad/range calibration fitting with coefficient uncertainty
Full-spectrum fitting and calibrated window integration
Propagation of count and stripping covariance into concentrations and ratios
Cross-survey calibration and mosaic QC without hiding detector differences

families.name: DC resistivity and ERT
families.existing_note: No dedicated ERT engine identified in the reviewed core modules.
families.required_data: A/B/M/N electrodes, current, voltage, coordinates/topography and acquisition errors
families.minimum_benchmark: Homogeneous half-space, reciprocal pairs, two-layer earth and a topographic inclusion model
candidates: ABMN survey schema and electrode geometry validation
Geometric factors and apparent resistivity with polarity conventions
Reciprocal-error and repeatability QC
Injected-current/contact-resistance QC and error models
1D sounding inversion and equivalence diagnostics
2.5D ERT inversion with topography
3D surface and crosshole ERT inversion
Time-lapse ERT with baseline and electrode-position uncertainty

families.name: Induced and spectral polarization
families.existing_note: No dedicated IP/SIP engine identified in the reviewed core modules.
families.required_data: IP decay gates/waveforms or complex impedances, timing, source waveform, electrode geometry and errors
families.minimum_benchmark: Synthetic decays/complex spectra, known gate integrals and electrode-coupling controls
candidates: TDIP gate integration and chargeability normalization
Full-waveform despiking and stacking with retained uncertainty
Decay QC including sign, late-time noise and coupling artifacts
2D/3D chargeability inversion coupled to a resistivity background
Complex resistivity and frequency-domain phase conventions
Cole-Cole parameter estimation with parameter tradeoff diagnostics
Debye relaxation distributions with regularization selection
Joint spectral/spatial IP inversion and interpretation limits

families.name: Frequency-domain electromagnetics
families.existing_note: No dedicated FDEM engine identified in the reviewed core modules.
families.required_data: Complex responses, frequencies, coil orientation/separation, altitude, phase convention and calibration
families.minimum_benchmark: Analytic half-space, layered models, coil rotation and independently computed responses
candidates: Instrument complex-response units and in-phase/quadrature normalization
Coil geometry, altitude and orientation QC
Primary/secondary field and phase calibration
Layered anisotropic-earth EM forward modeling
1D conductivity inversion with thickness/resistivity tradeoffs
Laterally constrained multi-sounding inversion
3D diffusive EM forward and inversion adapters
Multi-frequency calibration drift and noise-covariance handling

families.name: Time-domain and airborne EM
families.existing_note: No dedicated TEM/AEM engine identified in the reviewed core modules.
families.required_data: Time gates, transmitter waveform/current, receiver response, loop geometry, altitude and stacking errors
families.minimum_benchmark: Half-space/layered decays with finite gate integration and measured transmitter waveform
candidates: Raw transient stacking and gate-wise noise estimation
Transmitter-waveform and finite turn-off modeling
Receiver-response and finite time-gate convolution
Layered-earth transient forward modeling
1D conductivity-depth inversion
Spatially constrained multi-sounding inversion
3D TEM inversion with memory and solver budgets
DOI and waveform/height sensitivity diagnostics

families.name: Magnetotellurics
families.existing_note: No dedicated MT engine identified in the reviewed core modules.
families.required_data: Electric/magnetic time series or transfer functions, sensor orientation, timing, response metadata and errors
families.minimum_benchmark: Known impedance tensors, rotated layered earth, coherent remote reference and response convention checks
candidates: EDI/MTH5 transfer-function import with metadata preservation
Impedance tensor, apparent resistivity and phase conventions
Robust transfer-function estimation from time series
Remote-reference processing and coherence QC
Phase-tensor and dimensionality/strike diagnostics
Galvanic-distortion and static-shift sensitivity
Layered and 2D MT inversion adapters
3D MT inversion and uncertainty-aware survey design

families.name: Active seismic processing
families.existing_note: No dedicated seismic engine identified; generic channel filters are not a complete seismic processor.
families.required_data: Trace samples, sampling interval, source/receiver geometry, timing, component and instrument metadata
families.minimum_benchmark: Synthetic arrivals/reflections, field picks, adjoint dot tests and travel-time/velocity recovery
candidates: SEG-Y/SU acquisition geometry and trace-header validation
Trace/sampling/timing/polarity QC
Seismic filtering, deconvolution and f-k/Radon operators
First-arrival picking with uncertainty and editable picks
Refraction and travel-time tomography
Velocity analysis, NMO and stacking
Kirchhoff and least-squares migration adapters
Post-stack/pre-stack inversion with explicit wavelet and well-tie assumptions

families.name: Passive seismic and surface waves
families.required_data: Waveforms, calibrated three-component sensor orientation, array geometry and recording metadata
families.minimum_benchmark: Known spectral ratios and layered dispersion models with repeated windows/array configurations
candidates: miniSEED/StationXML ingestion and response removal
HVSR processing with window rejection and azimuthal checks
Ambient-noise correlation and station-pair QC
SPAC/f-k/beamforming array processing
MASW dispersion imaging and picking
Surface-wave dispersion inversion for Vs structure
Dispersion and resonance uncertainty with multiple modes/windows
Event detection, phase picks and location as a separate passive-seismic workflow

families.name: Ground-penetrating radar
families.existing_note: No dedicated radar-trace processor or GPR forward engine identified.
families.required_data: Raw radar traces, time-zero, antenna geometry/frequency, positions, calibration and velocity constraints
families.minimum_benchmark: Known reflectors/hyperbolas, layered FDTD examples and measured time/position calibration
candidates: GPR format import with antenna and positioning metadata
Time-zero correction and dewow
Bandpass and background-removal processing with signal-retention QC
Explicit gain models with quantitative-amplitude preservation options
Hyperbola/CMP velocity analysis with uncertainty
Migration and topographic correction
Time/depth slices with velocity-model provenance
FDTD forward-model adapter for benchmark generation

families.name: Borehole and petrophysical support
families.existing_note: General text ingestion does not establish dedicated well-log or borehole geophysical support.
families.required_data: Log curves, tool response, depth datum, deviation surveys, calibration and laboratory measurements
families.minimum_benchmark: Round-trip log metadata, known depth shifts and controlled laboratory/forward-response models
candidates: LAS and DLIS/LIS log ingestion with retained metadata
Log units, missing codes and depth-datum QC
Depth alignment and deviation-aware spatial positioning
Density/susceptibility/conductivity laboratory-data harmonization
Calibrated petrophysical relations with uncertainty and lithology groups
Crosshole electrical/seismic survey geometry adapters
Borehole EM response and coupling evaluation
NMR model feasibility and data-contract research before any implementation commitment

families.name: Self potential
families.existing_note: No dedicated self-potential engine identified in the reviewed core modules.
families.required_data: Potential differences, electrode/reference geometry, time/base records, drift/contact checks and explanatory geological/hydrological data
families.minimum_benchmark: Known electrical sources, reference-electrode changes, drift loops and independently predicted potential differences
candidates: Self-potential survey schema and reference-electrode conventions
Electrode drift and closed-loop adjustment
Time-variable background and telluric-noise QC
Potential-difference forward response for prescribed electrical sources
Source-current inversion with explicit boundary conditions
Electrokinetic interpretation feasibility with independent hydraulic constraints
Joint interpretation with resistivity without equating their physical parameters
Repeat-survey uncertainty and source-nonuniqueness diagnostics

families.name: Regional and geological context
families.existing_note: Airy and normal-gravity functions exist; global harmonics, flexure and geological-prior interfaces are different capabilities.
families.required_data: Global/regional field coefficients, reference ellipsoid, datum, bathymetry/topography and explicit geological constraints
families.minimum_benchmark: Known spherical-harmonic coefficients, synthetic flexure and independently checked geological surfaces
candidates: Global gravity/magnetic spherical-harmonic evaluation
Reference ellipsoid and vertical-datum-aware field comparisons
Flexural isostasy alternatives to Airy
Gravity-topography admittance and coherence
Localized/multitaper spherical spectral analysis
Fault/contact surface exchange with geological-modeling engines
Geological-prior rasterization onto inversion meshes with uncertainty
Consistent regional-to-local model and background transfer

families.name: Inversion quality and joint interpretation
families.existing_note: Density/susceptibility/MVI, scalar IRLS and cross-gradient functions exist; advanced diagnostics are separate work.
families.required_data: Forward operators, parameterization, errors/covariances, priors, bounds and repeatable solver settings
families.minimum_benchmark: Analytic/independent forward checks, adjoint tests, incompatible-prior cases and held-out observations
candidates: Sensitivity, resolution and depth-of-investigation diagnostics
Ensemble and posterior-approximation uncertainty workflows
Petrophysically guided multi-physics inversion
Shared-interface and cooperative alternatives to cross-gradient coupling
Time-lapse inversion with baseline and repeatability errors
Matrix-free/blocked/distributed forward and inverse execution
Systematic beta, bounds, regularization and mesh sensitivity suites
Independent benchmark catalog with scientific and software acceptance gates
